selection_reason: CSW-05 completed_verified in PR #429. APM-01 and CSW-05 satisfy APM-03 dependencies; owner-approved interleave selects APM-03 before CSW-06.
objective: Define a bounded AutoGM Single-Encounter Runner that can select/setup one governed encounter, accept player Actions, orchestrate NPC/world responses through explicit delegation, resolve mechanics in owning domains, stop at clear end conditions, persist/resume safely and reproduce governed mechanical outcomes for the same deterministic inputs without granting optional AI GM/canonical authority.
completion_gate: One bounded solo encounter can start, execute governed player/NPC turns, pause/resume and end with attributable summary/rewards while the same deterministic mechanical inputs produce the same governed outcome and optional narrative assistance cannot alter legality or canonical state.
required_design_questions: What is the encounter package/session model and what must be fixed before start?
How are Character eligibility, encounter package compatibility and difficulty/preferences validated without hidden rule changes?
How does AutoGM choose among only explicitly delegated NPC/world actions while owning domains resolve legality/mechanics?
How are initiative/turn windows, player Actions, reactions/interrupts and mandatory human choices represented?
How are deterministic random inputs/seeds recorded for replay without requiring presentation text to be identical?
How are hidden NPC/world facts filtered before player presentation and AI context?
What hard stop conditions prevent the controller from improvising beyond encounter scope?
How do defeat, retreat, surrender, objective completion, timeout/abort and unresolved endings behave?
How are rewards/loot/advancement proposals separated from automatic irreversible Character mutation?
What state is persisted for pause/resume/reconnect/idempotent duplicate Action handling?
How does optional AI narration/dialogue consume authorized resolved state without owning NPC mechanics or truth?
What deterministic fixtures prove same-input mechanical replay and no authority bleed?
preserved_parallel_tracks: APW-05 remains later in approved sequence
next_action: Execute APM-03 as a bounded design/governance tranche defining encounter package/session state, delegated controller loop, deterministic resolution/replay, hidden-information boundaries, stop/end/reward semantics, persistence/recovery and optional-AI presentation limits.
